title: Mirror permutation-orbit audit
hypothesis: Hidden permutations and positive hidden rescaling with inverse outgoing compensation preserve a ReLU MLP function and therefore add zero functional multiplicity; uncompensated Givens views change the function.
mirror_coordinate: a hidden-unit permutation, positive scaling, or Givens rotation code
logical_multiplicity: count only functionally distinct outputs; gauge-equivalent coordinates count as one
controls: positive scaling with inverse outgoing compensation
independent full weights as storage reference

development.selection_metric: symmetry output NRMSE and actual serialized bytes

storage.authority: actual serialized deterministic inference payload bytes

success_gate: Exact permutation, positive rescaling and compensated transform output NRMSE <=1e-6; uncompensated Givens output NRMSE >1e-3; gauge class has one unique logical output within tolerance.
failure_gate: An asserted exact symmetry exceeds 1e-6 or uncompensated Givens is <=1e-3 NRMSE.
boundaries: no trained model or task quality
audit/control only, not a compression win

amendment_A1.reason: The first implementation promoted random weight matrices to float64 while the serializer declared float32; payload reload verification exposed a dtype/byte-layout mismatch after initial fresh access. The A0 fresh rows are quarantined and excluded.
changes: Cast generated model weights explicitly to float32 before evaluation and serialization.
Add payload decoder and fresh hash/metric replay verification.
Use disjoint A1 development worlds 33221-33222 and fresh worlds 33231-33233; do not reuse A0 fresh worlds.
